notes.urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0084.tlg001.1st1K-gr: Τηλοί (1019) may be a corruption of another tribal name (Gelae?). Ἰλισσοῖς (1023) is read as Ἰλισσοῖο. The narcissite (1031) is a stone.

nodes.text: Of these, the fertile land toward the north is held
by the Teloi and the Mardoi and the men of Atropatene.
To the south dwell the tribes of the noble Medes,
sprung, you know, from that glorious lineage
of the daughter of Aeetes, the blameless heroine.
For when, beside the stream of Attic Ilissus,
she contrived baneful drugs for the son of Pandion’s son,
she left that place for shame, and into a deep-soiled
land that bore her name she came, wandering among men,
not far from the Colchians; for to reach the land of the Colchians
was not open to her: she dreaded her father’s wrath.
That is why even now there are men rich in drugs,
dwelling in a boundless country, some on the very
rocks that grow the lustreless narcissite,
